name: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
publisher: arXiv (Kwon et al.; vLLM / UC Berkeley)
notes: Paging-inspired KV cache: fixed-size blocks, near-zero waste, flexible sharing within and across requests. Reports 2-4x throughput improvement at same latency vs FasterTransformer and Orca, more pronounced at longer sequences and larger models.
